written.headline: New York launches portal for AI safety law requiring developer registration
written.summary: New York opened a registration portal for large frontier artificial intelligence developers as part of the RAISE Act. Companies with over $500 million in annual revenue must register by January 1, 2027, publish safety frameworks, and report critical safety incidents within 72 hours.

written.headline: Anthropic sets IPO price range aiming for up to $1.4 trillion valuation
written.summary: Anthropic submitted an updated S-1 filing for an IPO and concurrent private placement aiming to raise up to $88.5 billion. The offering sets a share price range of $70 to $78, implying a fully diluted valuation of up to $1.4 trillion.

written.headline: CoreWeave reports Q3 revenue up 168% YoY to $3.66B and $132.5B backlog
written.summary: CoreWeave reported third-quarter revenue of $3.66 billion, beating analyst estimates of $3.55 billion and marking a 168% year-over-year increase. The company also posted a net loss of $709 million and grew its revenue backlog to $132.5 billion.

written.headline: OpenAI reports $10 billion in Q3 revenue as enterprise demand grows
written.summary: OpenAI told investors its revenue jumped 50% to around $10 billion in the third quarter of 2026, up from 17% growth in the second quarter. More than half of the revenue came from enterprise clients, driven by demand for APIs and newer models like GPT-5.6 and Astra.

written.headline: Nvidia plans $10B investment in Anthropic alongside its IPO
written.summary: Nvidia plans to invest $10 billion in Anthropic alongside its initial public offering. The commitment is part of a larger funding effort that includes public share sales and private deals with multiple technology giants.
